We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need leaves commercially available chemicals, total price <= $9999.

We have some candidate building blocks: para-methyl aniline (p-toluidine) Cc1ccc(N)cc1 price cheap (28.6). Also bromosulfonic acid? Actually we need sulfonyl chloride maybe. The target has sulfonamide linking two aryl rings: p-tolyl-NH-SO2-aryl (para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide). The sulfonyl part attached to second phenyl which has a side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N- phenyl-NH (anilide). So we can think disconnection: break sulfonamide bond to give p-toluidine and aryl sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid). Also break amide bond to give aniline and cinnamoyl chloride? Actually side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N- phenyl-NH (anilide). That's an amide linking a phenyl amine to a cinnamoyl (trans-3-phenylacrylamide). So we can disconnect amide to give aniline (c3ccccc3N) and trans-cinnamoyl chloride (or acid). The trans-cinnamoyl part is attached to the aryl sulfonyl phenyl via a double bond: /C=C/ attached to aromatic ring (the second phenyl). Actually the second phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) has a para substituent of the cinnamoyl amide chain. So we can think: start from 4-bromo- or 4-iodo phenyl sulfonyl chloride? But we need sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl ring (aryl sulfonyl chloride). Could be 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride? However our target sulfonyl phenyl is unsubstituted phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) attached to sulfonyl group. So we need phenylsulfonyl chloride (benzenesulfonyl chloride). That's commercially available. Let's check price. Use search?
